article.headline: Sacred Heart opens the season with a 111-44 win over Coast Guard
article.description: — Jojo Wallace scored 21 points as Sacred Heart began the season with a 111-44 victory over Coast Guard on Monday.
article.linkText: Sacred Heart opens the season with a 111-44 win over Coast Guard

categories.description: Coast Guard Bears @ Sacred Heart Pioneers

event.description: Coast Guard Bears @ Sacred Heart Pioneers

keywords: Coast Guard Bears @ Sacred Heart Pioneers
article.story: FAIRFIELD, Conn. -- — Jojo Wallace scored 21 points as Sacred Heart began the season with a 111-44 victory over Coast Guard on Monday. Wallace shot 8 for 13 from the field, including 2 for 5 from 3-point range, and went 3 for 3 from the line for the Pioneers. Jaylen Robinson scored 16 points and added five rebounds. Griffin Barrouk shot 4 for 6 from the field, including 3 for 5 from beyond the arc, to finish with 11 points. Cormac Love led the way for the Bears with 12 points and two steals. Coast Guard also got nine points from Aiden Dabbondanza. Ashton Kendall added seven points. Up next Sacred Heart hosts Maine on Thursday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
